inv.desc_en:
COMMERCIAL PREMISES FOR RENT IN TRIANA - CALLE PUREZA AND SANTA ANA CHURCH AREA. -

INMO APGESTION offers this premises in Triana, ideal for storage, business, or a private office. -

Located on Calle Bernardo Guerra, on the side of the Santa Ana Church and just a few meters from Calle Pureza. -

It has its own bathroom and storage room. -

Rent: €820 (agency fees for intermediation: one month's rent + VAT). -

Immediate availability - We have the keys. -
